notes.title: Telestic Studios Update
notes.content:
Greetings from Telestic Studios! We've spent the past four years developing our adventure game [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SecondMarch.Runeflame]"Runeflame"[/url] which released today on the Google Play Store for Android. It's really exciting to have both Sanguo and Runeflame available for download, and we have plans to continue expanding both games with more content in the near future. For Sanguo specifically, we have plans for an amazing single-player campaign as well as more multiplayer matchmaking options and a multiplayer leveling system. While we don't have a release date yet, we're looking forward to all the new things to come.

We hope you enjoy the games!
